purpose: Original organic enemy references for local TRELLIS.2 and Blender; names are implementation proposals, not canon.

assets.name: Briarhide
assets.prompt: Create ONE original premium sculpted painterly PBR 3D creature asset reference for an ambitious dark-enchanted-forest game. A complete full-body biological enemy called a Briarhide: a powerful upright forest beast with a broad hunchback, long muscular forearms, digitigrade legs with wide grounded three-toed feet, short heavy neck and a distinctly animal wedge-shaped head with a blunt muzzle, small amber eyes under bony brows and two swept back branching antlers. It is living animal flesh, NOT a robot, cyborg, human in armor, toy or assemblage of primitive shapes. Weathered leathery olive/umber skin has real folds, tendons, pores, healed scars and pale freckling; dense asymmetrical moss/fur clumps run across the shoulders, elbows and spine; layered organic horn ridges grow from the shoulders and forearms, with ochre lichen, soft roots and occasional tiny ivory shelf fungi. Exquisitely crafted secondary and tertiary forms, large readable silhouette, tactile living anatomy and deliberate color/material transitions. Several exposed skin areas so it does not read as a tree statue. Broad hands with three clear thick fingers and hooked nails, mouths closed. Full-body neutral rigging A-pose, arms held 35 degrees out from torso, elbows slightly flexed, legs separated with all toes visible. Almost straight-on FRONT view, only a very slight three-quarter angle so both shoulders/arms/legs are equally clear. All limbs unobstructed and separate. Single isolated creature filling the square frame with generous border around antlers and feet. Genuine transparent RGBA background. Soft neutral studio illumination showing sculpted volume and all materials, no ground plane, no cast shadow, no scenery, no pedestal, no text or labels, no weapons or equipment. Original design with the craft and detail density expected from a high-end cinematic indie action game; substantial lifelike forms with restrained painterly surface treatment. This is a modelable 3D creature reference, not a flat illustration.

assets.name: MireSeer
assets.prompt: Create ONE original premium sculpted painterly PBR 3D creature asset reference for an enchanted wetland game enemy, called a Veilmouth. A complete full-body biological amphibian predator: lean upright biped, long bowed muscular legs with broad three-toed frog-like feet, slender long arms held clearly away from the body, three thick tapered webbed fingers on each hand. It has a small hunched torso, an elongated graceful neck and a striking broad head surrounded by a thick pleated organic gill collar like layered unfurling magnolia petals and cuttlefish fins. No antlers and no armor. The head is an animal, NOT human: a short flat salamander muzzle, two small widely spaced glossy dark gold eyes and a closed mouth. A ribbed amber throat sac provides a clear natural biological focal point. Fine fleshy folded gills at the jaw, irregular overlapping scale nodules on shoulders and shins, soft tendons, skin wrinkles, small natural healed scars, pearl-gray and muted blue-green skin with ivory undersides and copper freckles. Some dusky red petal edges and tiny moss wisps on the back imply damp old forest habitat. Every part looks alive and organic, not ceramic, machine, skeleton, statue or an object wearing clothes. Strong distinctive creature silhouette; exquisite modeled folds, broad anatomical forms and tactile detail with restrained painterly color transitions, high-end cinematic indie game craft. Full-body neutral rigging A-pose, arms 35degrees from torso, elbows almost straight, separated legs, both palms and all toes clearly visible. Straight frontal view with only a very slight three-quarter turn showing depth while keeping both sides clear, all limbs unobstructed and separate. ONE creature centered, full head/gill-frill tips and feet inside generous border. Genuine transparent RGBA background. Neutral soft studio lighting showing all materials and depth, no ground, cast shadow, scenery, pedestal, text, labels, particles, props, equipment or weapon. Original design; a fully modelable 3D creature asset reference rather than a flat illustration.
assets.note: Original file has genuine alpha, verified numerically; display showed RGB behind transparent pixels. An unnecessary later background-removal attempt produced RGB/checkerboard and was rejected, never used as a source.
